en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment' · also en — 'among' (en todos los sos 'among all his men') · also en + infinitive 'in (doing)' (en levarlo adelant 'in carrying it forward'); en çinco días 'in five days'
valençia: Valençia — Valencia, the Moorish kingdom and city whose king Tamín is addressed (= Valencia)
mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them') · also los de 'those of' (con los de Castejón 'with the men of Castejón')
sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus) · also los sos 'his own men' (possessive with article as noun; en todos los sos 'among all his men')
elle: elle — he (old form of él, Latin ille; elle fizo = él hizo; Pidal restores el[le])
ifantes: infante — young nobleman, son of a noble house (pl., spelt Ifantes; = infantes)
de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go') · also de + infinitive after a verb: començar de 'to begin to' (compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'), piénssanse de 'set about' (piénssanse de armar), aver de 'to have to' (lo que ha de far 'what he has to do') · also de — 'within' of a time limit (De aquestos quinze días, most likely 'within these fifteen days'; sense uncertain); de veluntad 'willingly'; de + superlative partitive (de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment')
carrión: Carrión — Carrión de los Condes, town in Palencia, seat of the counts of Carrión (= Carrión)
un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
escaño: escaño — bench, long seat with a back (masc. sg.; = escaño)
el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara) · also el de + place name 'he of, the one from' (mio Çid el de Bivar)
campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
mala: malo — bad, evil (fem.; la mala cárçel 'the evil prison'; = mala) · also of land, 'poor, wretched' (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly poor')
sabed: saber — know, take note of (imperative 2nd pl.; e vos sabed el mensage 'and you, learn the message'; = sabed)
que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him') · also que — what (indirect interrogative; dezir vos he que faze 'I shall tell you what he does'; = qué)
les: les — to them · also les — 'from them', dative of removal or injury (les tollió el pan 'took the bread from them'; viédales exir 'forbids them to go out')
la: el/la — the (fem.); her/it (object pronoun) · also la que 'the one that' (Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal')
e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold') · also aver — 'I will', the future auxiliary in a split future (quitarvos e … darvos e de mano 'I will free you … I will let you go'; = vos quitaré, vos daré) · also the full verb 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the delight I have of it')
león: León — León, the kingdom and city (Alfons el de León 'Alfonso of León'; = León)
se: se — himself/herself/itself (reflexive pronoun) · also se — passive 'is, are' (cómmo se gana el pan 'how bread is earned'; = se, passive-reflexive) · also se — ethic/intensive dative 'for himself, with his own eyes' (él se lo vío con los ojos 'he saw it himself')
por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain') · also por — 'in' after fiar (yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God') · also por — 'to fetch, for' after enbiar/ir (enbiaré por ellas, irán por ellas 'I shall send for them', 'they will go for them'); por cuenta 'by count, in a count' · also por — as (por heredad 'as a possession') · also por — 'about, after' with preguntar (por el rey tómanse a preguntar 'they begin to ask after the king'); por + infinitive 'for … to' (por … vençer reyes, 'for … to defeat kings')
medio: medio — middle; en medio de 'in the middle of' · also medio — 'the half' (noun; el medio echó en campo 'he threw the half onto the field'; = la mitad)
cort: cort — court, royal or lordly household (fem. noun; en mi cort 'in my court'; = corte)
enbraçan: enbraçar — to take (the shield) on the arm by its straps (present 3rd pl.; enbraçan los escudos 'they take their shields on their arms'; = embrazan)
del: de + el — of the (contraction) · also del standing for de + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (del albergada = de la albergada) · also del — 'from, for, because of' (cause; del gozo 'from the joy'; del çerviçio 'for the service')
fincan: fincar — they stop, cease (present 3rd pl.; non fincan de andar 'they do not stop riding'; = quedan, closest cesan)
sobre: sobre — upon, over; here 'on the security of' (sobre aquellas arcas) · sobre Navas de Palos 'above, hard by Navas de Palos' (position along the route) · also 'before, against (a town to be besieged)' (sobre Alcoçer iva posar 'went to camp before Alcocer') · also sobre — 'besides, in addition to' (Sobre aquesto todo 'on top of all this')
so: so/su — his, her, its (unstressed possessive sg.; so çervicio = su servicio); also seer — I am (1st sg. present; = soy; so ayrado, 'I am in [the king's] ira') · lo so — 'what is his, his own' (neuter article + possessive; lo so puede menguar 'what is his may dwindle') · also so — their (so consejo 'their counsel', so vino 'their wine'; = su)
vido: veer — he saw (strong preterite 3rd sg.; Pidal's vi[d]o; = vio)
dos: dos — two · also do + se, 'when/where … (they)' (Dos fallan con los moros 'when they come upon the Moors', Pidal 'cuando se encuentran'; = cuando se encuentran)
sol: sol — sun · also 'even, so much as' (sol non 'not even'; sol non será penssado 'it will not even be thought of') · also sol — so + l, 'under the' (so 'under', Latin sub, + el before a vowel): del sol espada 'from under the sword' (the likeliest reading; the construction is uncertain) · also Sol — doña Sol, one of the Cid's two daughters (personal name)
tanto: tanto — so much, so great · tanto quanto + subjunctive 'as long as' (tanto quanto yo biva 'as long as I live') · also tanto — 'so many' before a masc. sg. noun used collectively (tanto palafré, tanto buen pendón 'so many a palfrey, so many a good banner'; = tantos)
ovo: aver — he had (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = hubo; here perfect auxiliary, ovo bastidos = 'he had furnished') · ovo de + inf., little more than a plain past (las manos se ovo de untar 'his hands were smeared'); dont a ojo los ovo 'as soon as he had them in sight'
diziendo: dezir — saying (gerund; diziendo Minaya 'Minaya says', the gerund standing for a finite verb of speech; = diciendo)
boca: boca — mouth (besóle la boca 'he kissed his mouth'; = boca)
veré: veer — I shall see (future 1st sg.; = veré) · also veer con — to see to (a matter) with (lo veré con el Çid 'I shall take it up with the Cid')
tras: tras — after, behind (preposition; tras mio Çid 'after the Cid, in pursuit of'; = tras)
una: uno/una — one, a (fem.) · also a una — together, as one (adverbial; hivan a una compaña 'they went together'; a una grant ondrança 'together with great honor'; = juntos)
todo: todo — all, every (de todo conducho, 'with every kind of provision')
lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative) · also lo — neuter article 'what is' (lo to 'what is yours'); pleonastic 'it' (lo an, lo han a far; por tal lo faze 'for that reason he does it')
despertó: despertar — he woke up (preterite 3rd sg.; = despertó)
ora: hora — hour (= hora); en buen ora, part of the poem's honorific birth-formula, 'born in a good hour' · al ora 'at that very hour, then' (en ti crovo al ora) · also una grant ora — a long while (Pidal 'un gran rato'; = un buen rato)
naçió: nacer — he was born (preterite 3rd sg.; = nació)
mesnadas: mesnada — household troop, band of followers (pl.; = mesnadas)
o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?') · also o — where (relative adverb; o dizen Castejón 'which they call Castejón'; o el Campeador estava 'where the Campeador was'; = donde) · correlative 'either … or' (o me dexaredes … o … levaredes 'either you will leave me … or you will take away')
qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied') · indirect: que non sabe qué se far '(so that) she knows not what to do'; avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of' · also qué — how (exclamative before an adverb: qué bien pago 'how well he paid')
queredes: querer — you wish (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = queréis)
vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you')
ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already' · also ya — 'would', reduced imperfect of aver as conditional ending, 3rd sg., after infinitive + clitic (pagar se ya 'would be satisfied'; = -ía)
ondrado: ondrar — honored, esteemed (past part. as adjective, masc. sg.; rey ondrado 'honored king'; = honrado)
rebata: rebata — sudden alarm, surprise attack (= rebato)
nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us') · also nos' — non + se (aun nos' van del campo 'they are still not leaving the field'; the apostrophe marks the elision) · also nos — non + se, written without apostrophe (nin amigo a amigo nos pueden consolar 'nor can friend console friend'; mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him', the no redundant after the comparison)
fincó: fincar — he planted, set firm (preterite; fincar los inojos 'to kneel') · also fincar — he stayed, remained (el Campeador fincó con su mesnada 'the Cid stayed with his troop'; = quedó)
trae: traer — he carries, brings (present 3rd sg.) · also trae mal — 'treats badly, harries' (el salido de Castiella así los trae tan mal 'the exile from Castile treats them so badly')
al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el) · also a + el before an infinitive 'on, upon' (al exir de Salón 'on leaving the Jalón'; = al salir) · al 'the other thing, the rest' in al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later' · also por al 'otherwise, for any other reason' (non passará por al 'it will not be otherwise'); a mí mandedes al 'order me something else', give me another charge (the likelier reading of a terse line)
adeliñó: adeliñar — he made straight for, headed to (preterite)
para: para — toward, to (para Cataluyuth 'toward Calatayud'; = para)
vío: veer — he saw (strong preterite of veer 'to see'; = vio, here two syllables ví-o)
ante: ante — before; ante que 'before (that)' · also ante — because of, at (of the cause, like Latin prae; ante roído de atamores 'at the din of the drums')
cabeça: cabeça — head (= cabeza; ç sounded ts)
don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift') · also don — from where, whence (= donde, de onde; Castejón don abremos grand enpara 'Castejón, from which we shall have great protection') · 'whereof, with which' (Pidal 'de lo cual'; don yo sea pagado 'whereof I may be satisfied') · also don — when, where (= donde, of time; Don llegan los otros 'when the others come up')
rodrigo: Rodrigo — Rodrigo, the Cid's given name (= Rodrigo)
tomó: tomar — he took (preterite 3rd sg.; a dientes las tomó 'he took them with his teeth'; = tomó)
le: le — to him, him (dative pronoun) · also le — him, as direct object (leísmo; si ellos le prenden 'if they take him'); dative (non se le dava 'did not surrender to him') · also le — dative of separation, 'from him' (que nos le parte de so braço 'who does not leave his side'); dative 'for him' (ques le non spidiés 'who does not take leave of him')
metió: meter — he put (preterite 3rd sg.; metió mano 'laid hand to'; = metió)
a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront') · also a — 'with' of instrument (a dientes las tomó 'with his teeth he took them'; = con)
han: aver — they have (present 3rd pl.; = han); after an infinitive, the auxiliary of a split future (seervos han = os serán) · also han a + inf. 'they have to, are bound to' (mandado de so señor todo lo han a far); 'they hold, possess' (que moros las han) · also perfect auxiliary 'have' with a participle agreeing with its object (la ganançia que han fecha 'the booty they have made')
quantos: quanto — as many as (masc. pl.; todos quantos 'all who'; = cuantos)
i: e/i — and (variant of e before some sounds) · also i — there, therein (adverb, Latin ibi, like French y; meted i las fedes, 'put your pledged faith into it')
son: seer — they are (3rd pl.) · also son — perfect auxiliary of intransitives and passive auxiliary (todos son exidos 'have all gone out'; nombrados son; son derramadas 'are scattered')
tornáronse: tornar + se — they turned, set (to) (tornaron, preterite 3rd pl., + reflexive se; tornáronse a armar 'they set to arming themselves again'; = se volvieron)
palaçio: palaçio — hall, palace; the main room of a house (= palacio)
demandó: demandar — he asked for, inquired after (preterite 3rd sg.; demandó por Alfonsso 'he asked for Alfonso'; = preguntó por)
no: no — not (variant spelling of non) · also nos — to us (nos elided before lo: no' lo, 'to us it')
falló: fallar — he found (preterite 3rd sg.; quando los falló 'when he had found them (all assembled)'; = halló)
maguer: maguer — although (a rare word, of Greek origin)
están: estar — they are, stay (present 3rd pl.; = están) · also progressive auxiliary with a gerund (bendiziéndol están 'they are blessing him')
fallaron: fallar — they found (preterite 3rd pl.; = hallaron); fallar menos 'to find missing, to miss', Pidal 'echar de menos' (menos non fallaron 'they did not miss')
sin: sin — without · also sin — 'besides, apart from' (sin las peonadas 'besides the foot-soldiers'); sin falla 'without fail'; sin dubda
vidiestes: veer — you saw (preterite 2nd pl.; Pidal's vi[d]iestes; = visteis)
tal: tal — such; por tal 'for such a reason, for this purpose' (= tal)
commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne) · also commo si + imperfect subjunctive — 'as if' (commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing') · commo que 'as one who' (commo que ira a de rey … es echado 'as one who has the king's anger and is cast out') · also commo — 'as soon as, when' (commo gelo a dicho 'as soon as he told it him'); 'since, as' (commo fío por Dios 'as I trust in God')
iva: ir — he was going (imperfect 3rd sg.; iva posar 'was going to halt'; = iba) · ir + gerund, progressive 'was gradually doing' (yas iva alegrando 'was already cheering up'; miedo iva aviendo 'was going along with fear')
mandólo: mandar + lo — he ordered it (mandó 3rd sg. preterite + object lo, the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; mandólo y çercar 'he had him (the Cid; or 'it', the place) besieged there'; = lo mandó)
vedar: vedar — to forbid, prevent, cut off (infinitive; agua … vedar 'to deny water'; Latin vetare; closest prohibir, impedir)
tovieron: tener — they held, handled (strong preterite 3rd pl.; tovieron armas 'they played at arms' in the games, Pidal 'jugaron las armas'; cf. tenien armas; = tuvieron)
fiera: fiero — fierce, rugged, wild (fem.; la sierra que fiera es 'the range, which is rugged'; = fiera, fem. of fiero)
cosa: cosa — thing; nulla cosa 'anything' (after a negative, 'nothing'; = cosa)
pesa: pesar — it grieves, it distresses (present 3rd sg., impersonal; mucho pesa a los de Teca 'it greatly grieves the men of Ateca'; = pesa)
ellos: ellos — they, them (stressed 3rd pl. masc. pronoun)
estando: estar — being, standing (gerund; estando en la cruz 'while on the cross'; = estando)
pesar: pesar — grief, sorrow (noun; = pesar) · also pesar — to grieve (infinitive; non me a por qué pesar 'there is nothing to grieve me in it'; = pesar)
fuerças: fuerça — force, might; pl. forces, strong troops (por estas fuerças 'through these forces', i.e. among these hosts; = fuerzas)
marruecos: Marruecos — Morocco (rey de Marruecos 'the king of Morocco', i.e. the Almoravid ruler; = Marruecos)
çercar: çercar — to besiege, surround (infinitive; le van çercar 'they go to besiege him', ir + infinitive; = cercar)
campo: campo — field, open ground, field of battle (= campo; en el campo 'in the open field'; the element in Campeador) · campo de Taranz 'the plain of Taranz'
quarto: Quarto — Cuarte (Valencian Cuart), a place at the fourth milestone (Latin quartum) of the road from Valencia toward Castile; las torres de Quarto, Pidal: the towers on either side of the gate in Valencia's wall that opens on the road to Cuart (place name, restored by Pidal; = Cuarte)
fueron: seer/ir — they were (preterite 3rd pl., shared by ser and ir; todos fueron alegres 'all were glad'; = fueron)
posar: posar — to lodge, halt for the night (infinitive; = posar) · also to sit down, take a seat (ivan posar en un preçioso escaño 'they went to sit on a costly bench')
fincadas: fincar — planted, fixed in the ground (past part. fem. pl.; fincadas son las tiendas 'the tents are pitched'; = hincadas, clavadas)
ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay) · also ha — perfect auxiliary 'has' before the participle (ha vendido 'has sold'; fechos los ha ricos 'has made them rich') · also 'has, gets' (de señor non ha graçia 'he has no favor from a lord') · also ha de + inf. 'is to' (que los ha de aguardar 'who is to attend them'; aver de + infinitive, = ha de) · also non ha qui + inf. — 'there is no one to' (impersonal ha 'there is'; non ha qui tomallos 'there is no one to take them'; = no hay quien) · also ha — of time elapsed, 'it is, it has been' (Pocos días ha … que 'it is a few days since'; = hace)
las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
cabdales: cabdal — chief, principal (pl.; dos señas cabdales 'two chief banners'; = principales)
era: seer — it was (imperfect of seer = ser) · era + past part. 'had' (ser as pluperfect auxiliary with intransitives; Minaya assí era llegado 'Minaya had arrived')
sil: si + le — if … him (si + enclitic le; sil pudiessen prender 'if they could seize him'; = si le)
contar: contar — to tell, recount (infinitive; commo odredes contar 'as you will hear told'; = contar)
alegravas: alegrar + se — he rejoiced, was glad (imperfect 3rd sg. alegrava with the reflexive se run on; = se alegraba)
creçe: crecer — grows, increases (present 3rd sg.; = crece, ç sounded ts)
ganançia: ganançia — gain, profit, interest (= ganancia) · also booty, spoils of war (de ganançia 'as booty'; feremos grand ganançia 'we shall take great spoils')
grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had') · en grado tener 'to be thankful for' (en grado vos lo tengo 'I thank you for it')
mas: mas — but · also mas — 'most' (superlative, = más; en todo lo mas alto 'on the very highest part') · also mas — 'more' comparative (que es mas ondrada 'which is more honored'; = más)
ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain) · also ca non — 'and not that' (Pidal 'y no que'; cuédanse que es almofalla, ca non vienen con mandado 'they think it is an army, and not that they come with a message')
veyen: veer — they saw, were seeing (imperfect 3rd pl., veyen = veíen, the y a glide between the vowels; delante veyen so duelo 'they saw their grief before them'; = veían)
tantas: tanto — so many (fem. pl.; tantas lanças 'so many lances'; = tantas)
moros: moro — Moor (masc. pl.); a moros nin a cristianos, 'to any living soul' (merism)
sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure' · also por sabor de 'out of a wish to please, for the sake of' (por sabor de mio Çid 'to please the Cid')
part: part — share, portion (noun; = parte) · also part — side (del otra part 'on the other side'; = parte)
salidos: salir — gone out, sallied forth (past part. masc. pl. with the auxiliary seer; salidos son 'have gone out'; = salidos)
batalla: batalla — battle (= batalla; exir a batalla 'to sally out to battle')
entrar: entrar — to enter, set in (infinitive; = entrar)
abremos: aver — we shall have (future 1st pl., syncopated; = habremos) · also abremos a + inf. 'we shall' (aver a + inf. as a future: [abremos a ganar] = ganaremos)
es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida) · also es — that (apocopated esse = ese, demonstrative; en es alcaz 'in that pursuit', por es logar 'through that place')
aguisado: guisar — fitting, reasonable (past part. used as adj.; variant of guisado) · also ready, prepared (ser + part., impersonal: Ya es aguisado 'now all is arranged')
veer: veer — to see (= ver; two syllables) · also to review, inspect (troops) (mandó ve[e]r sus yentes 'had his men mustered'; Pidal: 'revistar') · also ir veer 'to go and attack' (iremos ve[e]r aquella su almofalla; Pidal 'atacaremos aquel su ejército')
poridad: poridad — secrecy, privacy, confidence (= puridad); en poridad 'in confidence' · also poridad — secret council, secret plan (aviendo su poridad 'holding their secret talk'; con esta poridad 'with this secret plan')
aquel: aquel — that one, whoever · also aquel — that (demonstrative adjective; aquel día de cras 'tomorrow'; aquella mayor az 'that biggest line')
muño: Muño — personal name (Muño Gustioz, a vassal of the Cid; = Munio, an old name; Nuño is probably related)
gustioz: Gustioz — patronymic 'son of Gustio' (Muño Gustioz, the Cid's retainer, brought up in his household; = Gustioz, no modern form)
vino: vino — wine (noun); also venir — he came (strong preterite 3rd sg.; por en vino a aquesto, 'that is how he came to this pass')
nuevas: nueva — news, tidings (fem. pl.; sus nuevas legavan 'his news was arriving'; = noticias, nuevas) · also nuevas — renown, fame (las nuevas de mio Çid sonando van; Pidal 'renombre, fama') · also nuevas — affairs, doings (las nuevas del cavallero 'the knight's affairs'; Pidal 'los asuntos, los negocios') · also nuevas — exploits, deeds (las nuevas que faze el Campeador; Pidal 'las hazañas que hace')
evades: evades — look, here you have (presentative; the make-up of the form is uncertain; = he aquí, ved aquí)
sí: sí — so, thus (optative particle, Latin sic; sí el Criador vos salue 'so may the Creator save you'; = así, no modern use as a particle) · also sí — himself, oneself (reflexive pronoun after a preposition; cada uno por sí 'each on his own account')
vala: valer — may he avail, protect (present subjunctive; vos vala 'may he keep you')
sean: seer — let them be (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive; todos sean contados 'let them all be counted'; = sean)
paz: paz — peace (= paz; moros en paz 'Moors at peace', i.e. those who have submitted)
vusco: vusco — you (old fused form, con vusco = con vos, 'with you'; cf. convusco)
valer: valer — to help, avail, protect (infinitive; in the split future valer me a 'will help me', infinitive + me + a = ha; = me valdrá)
dios: Dios — God · also Dios! — interjection of wonder (Dios, cómmo se alabavan! 'God, how they boasted!')
salve: salvar — may he save (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative; sí el Criador vos salve 'so may the Creator save you'; = salve)
lides: lid — battle, combat (fem. pl.; = lides, now only 'contest, dispute'; closest batallas)
d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another') · also d — 'about, concerning' (D' iffantes de Carrión yo vos quiero contar 'of the Infantes of Carrión I wish to tell you'; = de)
aquellos: aquel — those (masc. pl. demonstrative; con aquellos que 'with those who'; = aquellos)
sabidor: sabidor — one who knows, informed, in charge (= sabedor; vos seed sabidor 'you be the judge, the one who decides')
arrancar: arrancar — to drive off, rout (infinitive; a arrancar 'to be routed', passive-reflexive sense, cf. arrancada 'rout'; = ser derrotado, ahuyentado; modern arrancar 'to pull up, start') · also arrancar la lid — to win the battle, drive the foe from the field, active (yo la he de arrancar 'I must win it'; = ganar)
me: me — me, to me · also reflexive 'myself' (fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied')
merçed: merçed — mercy, favor; Merçed! 'have mercy, I beg you' (= merced) · also merçed — grace, favour (con la merçed del Criador 'by the grace of the Creator') · also en vuestra merçed 'at your disposal, at your command' (en vuestra merçed somos nos; Pidal 'estamos a vuestro mandar')
